notes.title: Release Stream
notes.notes: Release stream! This was a pre-recorded battle. Sorry about the two missing flag icons on the minimap, that has been fixed!

notes.title: New demo update!
notes.notes:
Hi, a new update for the demo has been published! It contains the following -

You can now right click on enemy icons to target them!

The previous "Hide" ability has been re-worked to be a Hold Fire/Fire at Will system. You can now move units that have been set to Hold Fire.

SMG infantry (except recon and units that have a Panzerfaust) are now equipped with an anti tank grenade. These will automatically be used against any enemy vehicle that comes within 30 meters of the SMG unit. Infantry can still use AP grenades against open top vehicles.

Units now display a "Panicking" icon above them when they are panicking.

Changed how deployed units are listed. They are now shown on the left side of the screen, separated into infantry and armor. You can hide or show the lists depending on your preference.

Added a tooltip when you hover over a unit purchase button. It now displays information on the unit so you can better choose what you want to buy.

Added a scrollbar to the armor section for unit purchasing. We want to make sure players know they can scroll down the armor units list to see more options!

Improved vehicle targeting priority. Vehicles will now attempt to target a unit that attacks them.

Improved camera rotation with the mouse wheel. It should be much smoother now!

Updated the tutorial to be up to date with the latest changes.

Fixed some issues with individual sound effects.

A lot of these changes came from player feedback, which we are really grateful for! Please let us know if you have your own feedback! Thanks!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we just released a new update for the demo! It includes the following - 

Fixed bugs with sound effects, including sounds previously not coming from the right direction.

Added engine and track sound effects to all vehicles. No more silent tanks!

Vehicles will now move in reverse if ordered to move behind them within 25 meters.

You can hold down the right mouse button to choose a facing direction when ordering units to move.

Game will now correctly pause when pressing the escape key in a battle.

Small improvements to Post Battle Report for dynamic campaign.

Other bug fixes.

Some of these came about directly from feedback we received, so thank you! Keep it coming!

See you on the battlefield commander!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and Demo update
notes.notes:
Hi, we are happy to announce our latest update to the demo!

Included in the latest update is the following: 

Dynamic Campaign! We are really excited to have this as part of the current demo! You can now play Dynamic Campaign as either the Germans or the Soviet Union. Everything should work, but things may change a little in the future.

A new map! Tannenberg Line is a new fully featured map that you can play Battle mode, Flags mode, and in Dynamic Campaign!

AI now has better priority targeting (tanks and armored cars will prioritize targeting enemy tanks and vehicles over infantry).

Optimizations for better performance, including a new option to change your in-game resolution.

Other small improvements and bug fixes.

We will be participating in the Steam Next Fest starting on Monday, so it's a great time to try out the demo! We are always ready for any feedback you have! Let us know!

notes.title: Update and Real-Time Strategy Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We have published a new update to the demo! Included in the update is the following - 
Tutorial - the game now has a short tutorial explaining the controls and mechanics of gameplay!
Unit icons have been updated for both player and enemy units!
Vehicles now have different components that can be damaged (tracks, gun, ammo rack, turret).
Lots of other small fixes and improvements.

We are also happy to be part of the Real-Time Strategy Fest!

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes: A new update for the demo is now live! It includes the ability to rotate the camera with your mouse wheel button and also adds icons above the enemy AI units for better visibility. This may be updated further in the future. Another modification was making "Elite" difficulty a little bit easier (AI gets 75% more RP's instead of 100% more). Let us know what you guys think!
